description: The teas.co.uk basket, only when the person asks. action "add" adds items (ids from teas or ask_lee; quantities add to what is there); "view" shows it with the subtotal and a delivery estimate; "update" sets one product (id) to a new quantity, 0 removes it; "checkout" returns a secure teas.co.uk link where the person signs in, chooses delivery and pays (it works for 7 days); "subscribe" gives the subscriber price and a link to set up a repeat delivery of one product (id); "undo" puts the basket back as it was before the last add or update, when nothing has changed since. Pass a fresh request_key with add or update: a retry with the same key never adds twice. Nothing is bought or charged here and payment details are never seen. Leave basket_id out on hosts that identify the person; otherwise pass the basket_id the first basket answer returned.

basket_id.description: Only for hosts that do not identify the person: the basket_id from the first basket answer.

id.description: For update or subscribe: the product id.

quantity.description: For update: the new quantity, 0 removes it.

request_key.description: Optional, for add and update: a new key for each change (8 to 80 letters, digits, dot, dash, colon or underscore). Sending the same change again with the same key does not add twice.

name: basket

outputSchema.description: The page or result; its shape depends on page, section or action.
